title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-29 06:50:07 最新章节：第224章 剑光垂落分割战场
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
【尊敬宿主，恋爱系统将为您服务。】
【您穿越到童话世界，本系统将辅助你击败童话故事中那些原本的主角们，攻略美丽的王后、公主们，让她们彻底臣服于您的魅力之下……】
【获得“特质：颠倒众生”（您的魅力提升至最大值，童话中的王后、公主们都将因为您的英俊而沦陷！）
获得“特质：完美之躯”（堪比神灵血脉的完美身躯，让您拥有无与伦比，强健诱人的体魄，足以让最忠贞圣洁的王后、公主们都彻底沉沦于欲望之中……）
获得“技能：洞察之眼”（您将看到旁人对您的好感度，更顺利地攻略目标角色……）】
……
看着面前只有自己才能够看到的系统界面，李凯南眉头皱起，忍不住嘀咕道：
“奇怪，怎么这么多乱码啊，语言补丁没打好？”
在李凯南的眼中，此时面前的系统面板上出现了很多乱码！
【尊敬宿主，？？系统将为您服务。】
【……穿越……**&%7^^，……击败……）9_=*&6^%54……国王……，攻……μ?xó?……彻底臣服……】
【获得“特质：？？？？”（您的魅力将提升至最大值，^%d*+……而沦陷……征服……**?＜.》}）
获得“特质：完美之躯”（堪比神灵血脉的完美身躯，让您拥有无与伦比的强健体魄，无论是nrА？？3^d*d8**Ъcr……）
获得“技能：洞察之眼”（您将看到别人对您的%*值，****……）】
……
穿越而来，必备金手指却天然带着bug，李凯南难免有些不高兴。
可惜就算是此时的他想找售后客服退换，也没有人搭理啊！
嗯，只能先勉强用着吧。
毕竟当年玩某些国外游戏，没有官方汉化版、也没有为爱发电汉化组的时候，他玩游戏也是经常“啃生肉”的……
所幸现在看起来影响还不大，起码新手礼包是能正常发放的！

此时的李凯南看着自己的系统面板，通过这一堆乱码中夹杂的中文文字连蒙带猜。
系统面板之上的内容，掺杂着诸如“击败”、“臣服”、“征服”这样的字眼。
再结合这个新手礼包的效果，看来结果已经很明显了！
魅力点满是用于招募手下，武力值拉满是要自己去冲锋陷阵。
而那个什么“洞察之眼”就更不用说了，争霸系统的新手标配技能，用来查看手下的忠诚度……
所以不用说，自己的这个金手指肯定是战争系统！
李凯南迈步走向了一旁的湖畔，伸手摘下自己头上的面甲。
低头看去，湖面倒映出一位身形高大，穿有着华丽浮雕的帅气鎏金板甲，披着红色披风的英武黑发少年。
本来就俊朗英武的五官，此时在“？？？？”特质的加持之下，浑身更是萦绕着一股无与伦比的魅力，让人根本挪不开眼睛！
李凯南透过湖面打量了半天，不由点了点头。
还行，还是自己原本那张脸！
李凯南是直接身穿过来的，就连他身上的这套以“参加cosplay”的名义专门花大价格定制的重型全身板甲都顺便带过来了……
content_en:
[Respect the host, the love system will serve you. 】
[You travel to the world of fairy tales, and this system will help you defeat the original protagonists in fairy tales, conquer the beautiful queens and princesses, and make them completely surrender to your charm...]
[Acquire "Trait: Confuse all living beings" (your charm is increased to the maximum, and the queens and princesses in fairy tales will fall because of your handsomeness!)
Obtain "Trait: Perfect Body" (a perfect body comparable to the blood of gods, giving you an unparalleled, strong and attractive body, enough to make the most loyal and holy queens and princesses completely immersed in desire...)
Obtain "Skill: Eye of Insight" (you will see the favorability of others towards you and attack the target character more smoothly...)】
…
Looking at the system interface in front of him that only he could see, Li Kainan frowned and couldn't help but mutter:
"Strange, why are there so many garbled characters? The language patch has not been applied properly?"
In Li Kainan's eyes, there were a lot of garbled codes on the system panel in front of him!
[Respect the host,? ? The system will work for you. 】
[...travel...**&%7^^,...defeat...) 9_=*&6^%54...King..., attack...μ?xó?...completely surrender...]
[Acquire "Trait: ????" (Your charm will be increased to the maximum value, ^%d*+...and fall...conquer...**?＜.》})
Obtain "Trait: Perfect Body" (a perfect body comparable to the blood of gods, giving you an unparalleled strong body, whether it is nrА??3^d*d8**Ъcr...)
Obtain "Skill: Eye of Insight" (you will see the %* value of others towards you, ****...)】
…
Traveling through time, the necessary golden finger naturally has bugs, which makes Li Kainan inevitably a little unhappy.
It's a pity that even if he wanted to contact the after-sales customer service for a return or exchange at this time, no one would respond!
Well, I can only use it reluctantly for now.
After all, when he was playing some foreign games and there were no official Chinese versions and no Chinese version for Love, he often "gnawed on raw meat" when playing games...
Fortunately, it seems that the impact is not big now, at least the novice gift packs can be distributed normally!
At this time, Li Kainan looked at his system panel and made guesses through the Chinese characters mixed in the garbled code.
The content on the system panel is mixed with words such as "defeat", "surrender" and "conquer".
Combined with the effect of this novice gift pack, it seems that the results are already obvious!
Use all your charm points to recruit subordinates, and use all your force points to charge into battle yourself.
Not to mention the "Eye of Insight", a standard skill for novices in the hegemony system, used to check the loyalty of their subordinates...
So needless to say, my golden finger must be the war system!
Li Kainan stepped towards the lakeside and reached out to take off the mask on his head.
Looking down, the lake reflected a tall, heroic black-haired young man wearing handsome gilt plate armor with gorgeous reliefs and a red cloak.
The originally handsome and heroic facial features, now under the blessing of the "????" trait, are filled with an unparalleled charm, making people unable to take their eyes away!
Li Kainan looked through the lake for a long time and couldn't help but nodded.
Not bad, it’s still the same face as before!
Li Kainan wore it directly, and even the heavy-duty full-body plate armor he wore, which was specially customized at a high price in the name of "participating in cosplay", was also brought over...
